```{r, publication_theme}

theme_Publication <- function(base_size=14, base_family="sans") {
      library(grid)
      library(ggthemes)
      (theme_foundation(base_size=base_size, base_family=base_family)
       + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(0,0,20,0)),
               text = element_text(),
               panel.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
               plot.caption.position = "plot",
               panel.border = element_rect(colour = NA),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = rel(1)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust =2),
               axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
               axis.text = element_text(), 
               axis.line.x = element_line(colour="black"),
               axis.line.y = element_line(colour="black"),
               axis.ticks = element_line(),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="#f0f0f0"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
               legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.direction = "horizontal",
               legend.box = "vetical",
               legend.key.size= unit(0.5, "cm"),
               #legend.margin = unit(0, "cm"),
               legend.title = element_text(face="italic"),
               plot.margin=unit(c(10,5,5,5),"mm"),
               strip.background=element_rect(colour="#f0f0f0",fill="#f0f0f0"),
               strip.text = element_text(face="bold")
       ))
      
}

```

```{r, interest_vars}
full_set <- read_csv("sources/full_feature_set.csv")

interest_vars <- full_set |> 
  select(c(logit_share_military_conflict,
           logit_share_election_democracy,
           logit_pct_strong_neg_identity_division,
           logit_pct_strong_neg_election_democracy,
           logit_pct_strong_neg_information_environment,
           log_tone_var_election_democracy,
           Y_domestic))
label_map <- c(
  logit_share_military_conflict = "Military Conflict Share",
  logit_share_election_democracy = "Democratic Election Share",
  logit_pct_strong_neg_identity_division = "Identity Division Share Negative",
  logit_pct_strong_neg_election_democracy = "Democratic Election Share Negative",
  logit_pct_strong_neg_information_environment = "Info Environment Share Negative",
  log_tone_var_election_democracy = "Democratic Election Tone Variance"
)
```

```{r, x_y_graphs}
interest_vars |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -Y_domestic, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  filter(between(value, quantile(value, 0.025), quantile(value, 0.975))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = Y_domestic)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "firebrick", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(variable = label_map)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme_Publication() +
  labs(title = "Top Features vs. Domestic Disinformation Score",
       x = NULL, y = "Y Domestic",
       caption = "SOURCE: GDELT & Digital Society Project \nExplantory variables have been log transformed. \nSmoother is clipped to the middle 95% of each variable's range to limit distortion")
```

```{r, importance_measures}
importances <- read_csv("~/GitHub/project-workbook-maggie-elliana/shared_data/feature_importances.csv") |> 
  select(feature = `...1`, importance = `0`)

themes <- c(
  "military_conflict",
  "identity_division",
  "information_environment",
  "election_democracy",
  "economic_instability",
  "cybersecurity_infrastructure",
  "governance_trust",
  "climate_environment",
  "migration_displacement",
  "public_health_crisis",
  "social_unrest"
)

theme_pattern <- paste0("(", paste(themes[order(-nchar(themes))], collapse = "|"), ")$")

importances <- importances |>
  mutate(
    theme = str_extract(feature, theme_pattern),
    measure = str_remove(feature, paste0("_?", theme_pattern)) |> str_remove("_$")
  )
```

```{r, importance_labels}
theme_labels <- c(
  military_conflict = "Military Conflict",
  identity_division = "Identity Division",
  information_environment = "Info Environment",
  election_democracy = "Election / Democracy",
  economic_instability = "Economic Instability",
  cybersecurity_infrastructure = "Cybersecurity",
  governance_trust = "Governance Trust",
  climate_environment = "Climate / Environment",
  migration_displacement = "Migration / Displacement",
  public_health_crisis = "Public Health Crisis",
  social_unrest = "Social Unrest"
)

measure_labels <- c(
  logit_share = "Article Share",
  logit_social_share = "Social Media Share",
  logit_pct_strong_neg = "% Strongly Negative",
  logit_pct_strong_pos = "% Strongly Positive",
  log_tone_var = "Tone Variance",
  log_polar_var = "Polarity Variance",
  log_activity_var = "Activity Variance",
  log_group_var = "Group Variance",
  log_n = "Article Count",
  log_avg_words = "Avg. Word Length",
  clr_short_share = "Short Article Share",
  clr_medium_share = "Medium Article Share",
  clr_long_share = "Long Article Share"
)

importances <- importances |>
  mutate(
    theme_label = recode(as.character(theme), !!!theme_labels),
    measure_label = recode(as.character(measure), !!!measure_labels)
  )
```

```{r, importance_heatmap}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(importances, aes(x = measure_label, y = theme_label, fill = importance)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Importance") +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.key.height = unit(1.25, "cm")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Measure", y = "Theme", 
       title = "Feature Importance by Theme and Measure \nin RF Predicting Domestic Disinformation Dissemination",
       caption = "SOURCE: GDELT Project & Digital Society Project")
```
